headword: {車内広告|しゃないこうこく}

definitions.gloss: in-vehicle advertising; advertisements inside trains and buses
definitions.explanation: Advertising displayed inside public transportation vehicles, particularly trains and buses. A distinctive feature of Japanese urban life, including hanging posters, stickers above windows, digital screens, and wrap advertisements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車内広告|しゃないこうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}った→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I learned about a new product from an ad inside the train.

examples.japanese: {車内広告|しゃないこうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通勤客|つうきんきゃく}⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: In-train advertising is particularly effective for commuters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{車内広告|しゃないこうこく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦デジタル{化|か}→デジタル化：08829_dejitaruka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧、⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, in-train advertising has gone increasingly digital, with more video ads appearing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{車内|しゃない}→車内：06203_shanai⟧ (inside a vehicle) + ⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧ (advertisement). A ubiquitous part of daily life for Japanese commuters.

Japanese trains are famous for their dense advertising — rows of hanging posters (⟦{中吊|なかづ}り→中吊り：16930_nakazuri⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧) above passengers' heads, stickers on windows and doors, and increasingly digital displays showing video content. These ads cover everything from magazines and cosmetics to language schools and job listings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{中吊|なかづ}り→中吊り：16930_nakazuri⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧: hanging poster ad (inside trains)
- {車内広告|しゃないこうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to place an in-train ad
- {車内広告|しゃないこうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掲載料|けいさいりょう}: advertising rate for in-vehicle ads
- ⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧{車内広告|しゃないこうこく}: digital in-train advertising

- ⟦{中吊|なかづ}り→中吊り：16930_nakazuri⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧: hanging ad — the specific poster type hung from the ceiling
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧: station advertising — ads at the station rather than inside trains
- {屋外広告|おくがいこうこく}: outdoor advertising — billboards and outdoor signs
